summary: In this excerpt from a fiction book (Book 14, part 45), a group of students is assigned a museum-style project with a flowchart, and they argue over the choice of theme. The narrator sides with the green option and picks "animals" over "communities" after a comic exchange with Nikko. Dave arrives late and Marcella, who runs the group, sends everyone to assemble in the lobby in an hour. The narrator then talks privately with Nikko about Zip, the police, the FBI agent, Wheeze, and her brother Wilson, while hiding details of the Group's investigation.
one_line: Excerpt from Book 14 in which the narrator and Nikko debate a group project's theme and she confides in him about Zip, Wheeze and her brother Wilson.
key_facts: Nikko makes a mock bow with his wool cap, saying "Pray, madam, read on."
Nikko says he figured the narrator was involved and that she doesn't know the people behind the rally.
The rally group has a website, a Facebook page, a Twitter account and a YouTube channel.
Nikko offers to pick the narrator up for the rally, and she says she will ride her bike.
Dave arrives late with an explanation about car problems and traffic, and Marcella hands him a flowchart.
The narrator says she votes for the second option, the one in green.
The narrator and Nikko disagree on the theme, with her saying "Communities" and Nikko saying "animals", and then they swap words.
Dave says he will go with what everybody else wants.
Marcella orders the group to assemble in the main lobby in exactly one hour to report.
Marcella takes Dave to the medieval art section, and the group is assigned European and contemporary art.
The narrator tells Nikko about Zip, the cops who came to the apartment, and her worry about Wheeze.
The narrator nearly reveals what the Group dug up on Zip's identity and an FBI agent Zip works with, but makes it sound like her own research.
The narrator says the Group is private and talks about Wilson taking care of her when she was little.
The narrator had wanted to go with Wilson when he turned eighteen.
